description: Godot run: read output and errors of a game started with godot_run_start (process or editor mode). Use level "error" to see only errors, and "since" (the "next" value from the last call) to page.

errors.description: Script errors with backtraces instead of lines (repeats merged).

run_id.description: Default: the running game (latest run). "editor" for the editor's.

title: Game output
